1372.1001.1.description:
MACs are learned after MAC learning is from loop detection then brought up again from LACP

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that MAC learning recovers after loop detection (loop-protection) has shut MAC learning down on a port, once the port is brought back up by forming an LACP etherchannel. Builds a multi-member stack with partner switches and loop-protection enabled, injects a frame to trigger a loop-protection event that blocks/stops learning, then creates an etherchannel between the stack and the partner to bring the link back up. Confirms newly sent source MACs are subsequently learned in the MAC address-table, the stack stays in a good state, the running-config is preserved after teardown, and no exceptions occur.

1372.1001.2.description:
MACs are learned after MAC learning is stopped from port-security then brought up again from LACP

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that MAC learning recovers after port-security has stopped learning on a port, once the port is brought back up by forming an LACP etherchannel. Builds a multi-member stack with partner switches, sends frames to trigger a port-security intrusion that halts MAC learning, then configures a port-secure etherchannel between the stack and the partner to flush and re-enable learning. Confirms newly sent source MACs are subsequently learned, the stack stays in a good state, the running-config is preserved after teardown, and no exceptions occur.

1372.1001.3.description:
MACs are learned after MAC learning is from thrash detection then brought up again from LACP

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that MAC learning recovers after thrash detection has stopped learning on a port, once the port is brought back up by forming an LACP etherchannel. Builds a multi-member stack with partner switches, drives the network into a MAC-thrashing condition so the affected interfaces stop learning, then creates an etherchannel between the stack and the partner devices to bring the link back up. Confirms newly sent source MACs are subsequently learned, the stack stays in a good state, the running-config is preserved after teardown, and no exceptions occur.
